prompt:
A stationary nucleus of total mass 3.80 x 10^-25 kg undergoes radioactive alpha-decay, emitting an alpha particle of mass 6.64 x 10^-27 kg at a speed of 1.60 x 10^7 m s^-1.
(a) State the total linear momentum of the system before the decay occurs. [1]
(b) Calculate the magnitude of the momentum of the emitted alpha particle. [1]
(c) Calculate the mass of the recoil daughter nucleus. [1]
(d) Calculate the recoil speed of the daughter nucleus. [1]
hints: Momentum of the daughter nucleus must be equal and opposite to that of the alpha particle.
solution:
(a) Initial momentum = 0 kg m s^-1.
(b) p_alpha = m_alpha v_alpha = (6.64 x 10^-27 kg) x (1.60 x 10^7 m s^-1) = 1.06 x 10^-19 kg m s^-1.
(c) Mass of daughter nucleus M_d = (3.80 x 10^-25 kg) - (6.64 x 10^-27 kg) = 3.73 x 10^-25 kg.
(d) By conservation of momentum, M_d v_d = p_alpha => v_d = (1.0624 x 10^-19 kg m s^-1) / (3.7336 x 10^-25 kg) = 2.85 x 10^5 m s^-1.
